title: Operator attention
summary: Landed-without-close-out rows are classified from the item's own done-gate facts, not holder posture: a landing waiting only on its active flow's next release is one command-free line, and only owed close-out names a wake or close-out. Landed-work custody reads current memberships and landing receipts each pass. Repository containment reuses definite answers for immutable full commit pairs; unknown comparisons retry and remain visible as unreadable custody. The steering report adds a slow paths section only when a function operation's last-hour p95 passes 5 s or a call passes 30 s; intentional waits such as the relay long-poll stay out. The steering seat treats a row that should resolve by itself (an unmergeable queue entry, a missing notice, a refused worker command) as a system gap to root-cause and record in a feedback before any manual step; an unmergeable queue entry belongs to its holder and the landing observer, so the seat does not message the holder.
